n01.text: Every great game starts the same way. A field. A ball. And your friends.

n04.text: Say any game. Play it outside. Your phone is the referee.

n05.text: Just say what you want to play.

n06.text: FieldDay designs the game, checks that it's safe, and reads you the rules.

n08.text: It watches every throw. Every jump. And measures it.

n09.text: Turn battles. Team battles. Chaos mode.

n10.text: Or team up, and take down a boss.

n11.text: Quests send you across the park. Race to the biggest tree. Find something red.

n12.text: Your phone checks the photo, right on the device.

n13.text: Challenge friends in another city, live. Only the score travels. Your video never leaves your phone.

n14.text: No signal? No problem. The brain runs right on your phone.
